source.title: Probing False Vacuum Decay on a Cold-Atom Gauge-Theory Quantum Simulator

genuine_novelty: Published cold-atom analog-simulator investigation of out-of-equilibrium pair production in a 1+1D U(1) lattice-gauge quantum-link model with tunable background field and reported excitation peaks.
limitations: Not a direct cosmological false-vacuum decay observation or direct pair production in empty space.
Finite lattice/model truncation, preparation, boundary, control/readout and mapping-to-continuum assumptions remain.
No independent UQPU reproduction, real-QPU run, cost comparison or new physical law is claimed.

falsifiable_follow_up.method: Freeze source model and hashes; compare independent exact-diagonalization and MPS references; reproduce pair-density and excitation observables across preregistered parameter and lattice-size splits; use null/background-field/boundary controls; report errors, uncertainty and full resources.
falsifiable_follow_up.falsifier: Failure to reproduce within preregistered tolerance, disappearance on held-out parameters/finite sizes, or equal explanation by a null/control model.
falsifiable_follow_up.evidence_gate: LITERATURE_ONLY until independent reproduction; no mission promotion from simulator execution alone.

lane_review.A: future accepted-observable contract and classical reference comparison proposed; no code changed

next_gate: Independent source-exact small-lattice reproduction with held-out parameter regimes and counterexample controls.
